import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
open scoped BigOperators
theorem postage_representable_large (n : ℕ) (hn : 28 ≤ n) : ∃ five eight : ℕ, 5 * five + 8 * eight = n := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem postage_representable_large (n : ℕ) (hn : 28 ≤ n) : ∃ five eight : ℕ, 5 * five + 8 * eight = n
proof
  have h1 : ∃ k : ℕ, n - 28 = 5 * k, by
    have h2 : 0 ≤ n - 28, by linarith [hn]; 
    have h3 : 0 ≤ 5 * k, by linarith; 
    exact nat.exists_of_nonneg h2 (nat.exists_of_nonpos h3 (nat.sub_nonpos_of_le h1));
  obtain k, hnk : n - 28 = 5 * k, from h1;
  have h4 : 5 * k + 8 * 4 = n, by linarith [hnk];
  exact ⟨k, 4, h4⟩
end
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : Nl2LeanExpected.postage_representable_large = Nl2LeanCandidate.postage_representable_large := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
